title: AfterMe
tagline: Posthumous Digital ID Management and KVault. We are creating a UI for a users to create rules for what should happen to their Digital Identity (e.g. social media accounts) after they are deceased
description:
We have developed two complimentary ideas. One is AfterMe and the other is AfterMe Registry. 
The purpose of AfterMe is Posthumous Digital ID Management. The users can create actions with regards to what happens to their Social Media accounts, their cloud storage accounts and any other digital legacy to do with ID and Data.
The AfterMe Registry is a platform the intends to solve the Oracle problems. It is a platform for third party Attestation providers, such as insurance companies, institutes and such. Third Parties signers like insurance companies are often embedded in current legal frameworks, we want to utilise that and bring it on-chain. This gives users the opportunity to choose from service providers that have on-chain presence and it gives third party services to be on-chain
how_its_made:
- We have used Web3Auth for authentication and signing of contracts. 
- We used Sign Protocol for Creating Schemas and Attestations. 
- We used Lit Protocol for encryption and decryption
- We used Tableland for data storage
- We used Chainlink to send API calls 
- We XMTP for wallet to wallet messages
- We also used traditional web2 services
